text: Cecil frowned in disappointment as he focused upon the printing to find no Govr. no Compa., in fact no five pound notes at all. He was holding a paper booklet, the top sheet of which bore, in large Baskerville type, the words METROPOLITAN Printing to find no Gorr, no Lompu.y infait no Fire poune! notes at all. He was holding a paper booklet, the top sheet of which bore, in large Baskerville type, the words MONOTECHNIC INSTITUTE ADVANCED ALLOUNTANCY COuRsE N0.3.
name: Cecil
